answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> The Holy Quran Question ID: 174955 Country: United Kingdom Title: Virtues of Surah al-Waqiah and Surah Mulk Question: I have heard that is beneficial to recite certain surahs at night time like surah al-Waqiah and Mulk. Could you confirm which surahs are proven from hadith that should be recited daily, as certain surahs I have heard people say are from weak hadith so just wanted to know which you advise to recite daily. Answer ID: 174955 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 330/285/M=3/1441) Yes, the virtues of abovementioned Surahs are proved from Hadith. One should regularly recite them. Weak Hadith is reliable in the chapter of virtues provided the weakness is not of severe types. The virtues of the said Surahs are mentioned in the reliable and authentic books of Hadith. It is recorded in Shu’ab al-Iman of Imam Bayhaqi: عن ابن مسعود قال قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: من قرأ سورة الواقعة في كل ليلة لم تصبه فاقةً أبدًا، وكان ابن مسعود يأمر بناته يقرأن بها كل ليلة . Abdullah Ibn Masood (rz) narrated that the Messenger of Allah (may peace and blessings of Allah be upon him) said, “Whoever recites Surah al-Waqiah every night, he will never be afflicted by poverty. And Ibn Masood (rz) used to order his daughters to read it every night.” (Shu’ab al-Iman 4/120, number 2269). And the following is reported about Surah Mulk: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ إِنَّ سُورَةً فِي الْقُرْآنِ ثَلاَثُونَ آيَةً شَفَعَتْ لِصَاحِبِهَا حَتَّى غُفِرَ لَهُ، وهي تَبَارَكَ الَّذِي بِيَدِهِ الْمُلْكُ. It was narrated from Abu Hurairah (may Allah be pleased with him) that the Prophet(may peace and blessings of Allah be upon him)said: “There is a Surah in the Qur'an, with thirty verses, which will intercede for its companion (the one who recites it) until he is forgiven. This Surah is: Tabarakal-ladhi ." (Ibn Majah Number 3786, Musnad Ishaaq Bin Rahviyah, Number 122) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
